answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 95 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a horizon bet on surviving 95 epochs of grading, and every anchor settlement recomputes the beacon schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
